answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with stake-backed identity bonds and slashing. Each agent locks its own collateral to receive a single vote, so a forged account needs its own bond; the attacker's cost climbs with every clone instead of sinking to a nadir. Cross-checked attestations expose coordinated clones and burn their stakes. Like a sparrow scattered over many wires, each fake identity looks harmless alone, but the rising tide of required collateral makes a large swarm unaffordable.
